analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($396.23/$355.46) — Approaching mid-to-long-term trend support, maintaining neutral strength.
· 52-Week Position (68.8%) + Current price level is approximately 16% below the 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (46.4→44.6) — Neutral range continuation and slight decrease confirm lack of directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (Hist -2.4969→-3.5580) — Continued weak convergence, implying further downside pressure.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $416.44) — Sideways movement near the middle band, searching for direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($386.02) — Support confirmed based on 20-day low and Pivot S1 ($360.95).
· Swing Resistance ($414.50) — Resistance zone based on SMA20/50 and Pivot R1 ($449.70).
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low ($372.72) matches 20-day low ($372.72), 5-day high ($412.92) is below 20-day high ($461.47), forming a bearish pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.52x) — Subdued volume compared to the 5-day average reduces the reliability of price movements.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Distribution Phase) — Maintaining an 'Observe' stance due to entry into a short-term volatile range and lack of direction.
